Table_Delimited.name: PIXL HOUSEKEEPING SPREADSHEET
Table_Delimited.description: PIXL housekeeping table, converted to engineering values

Field_Delimited.name: SCLK
Field_Delimited.description: The spacecraft clock time. This is an on-board 64-bit counter, in units of nano-seconds, which increments once every 100 milliseconds. Time zero corresponds to midnight on 1-Jan-1980.

Field_Delimited.name: PMC
Field_Delimited.description: The PIXL Motion Counter is a counter representing a change to the PIXL Hexapod position. The counter increments by 1 each time the hexapod is moved.

Field_Delimited.name: RTT
Field_Delimited.description: PIXL Round Trip Tracking Token

Field_Delimited.name: hk_fcnt
Field_Delimited.description: Frame Counter (16-bit): The number of HK frames that have been sent since power on.

Field_Delimited.name: u_hk_version
Field_Delimited.description: The version of the FPGA configuration

Field_Delimited.name: u_hk_time
Field_Delimited.description: The number of seconds since power on, or the number of seconds since the value sent in the last TIME_SYNC command. HK_TIME starts at 0 when PIXL is powered up and counts up once per second.

Field_Delimited.name: u_hk_power
Field_Delimited.description: The CONTROL_POWER register, which shows all the power switches and enables that are currently ON (see the PIXL Command and Telemetry Dictionary for decoding instructions).

Field_Delimited.name: u_fsw_0
